# Isaiah Chapter 45 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 25 verses]*

*Cyrus anointed; God forms light and darkness; potter and clay; every knee shall bow*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other. This chapter cyrus anointed.

*-- LOGOS*
